state_at_writing: Physics 101 fall-scenario videos partially downloaded; one trial (w_block_10/foam/01) previewed to see the camera layout; no prediction, mask or statistic computed on any trial.

dataset.name: Physics 101 (Wu et al., BMVC 2016), release v1.0, http://phys101.csail.mit.edu/data/phys101_v1.0.zip
dataset.subset: scenarios/fall: 33 objects of 12 material categories, 5 landing surfaces (foam, glass, metal, rug, table), 666 trials
dataset.view: Camera_1.mp4 (front DSLR, 1920x1080, ~30 fps, ~36 frames). Single view; Kinect_RGB_1 only as a secondary robustness view if time permits.
dataset.gt: dataset material category per object (+ measured mass g / volume mL, reported only). No per-object stiffness is measured by the dataset; stiffness GT is a pre-registered literature value per material category (below).

preprocessing.background: per (surface setting) median over frames sampled from all trials of that setting (Camera_1 fixed per setting); if a trial's frame-0 differs from the setting background by >15 gray levels median outside the top 25% of the image, fall back to a per-trial median background
preprocessing.mask: max-channel |frame-bg| > 30 after 5x5 Gaussian blur, morphological open(3)/close(7); components touching the top image border = hand/arm, discarded; object = largest remaining component with area >= 150 px
preprocessing.release: first frame from which an object component exists in this and the next 2 frames; clip = release frame to the last frame
preprocessing.crop: fixed square crop = union object bbox over the clip, side x1.35 (min 96 px), resized to 224; object on black (frame x mask), same as V3f Spring-Gaus preprocessing
preprocessing.frames: clip frames -> 64 by nearest repetition, times in seconds from the video fps
preprocessing.qc_exclusion: trial excluded if: no release found, < 8 post-release frames, or object mask present in < 80% of clip frames. Exclusions reported per category; no other filtering, no manual curation.
preprocessing.model: V2 main 9-run B/C/D ensemble (scripts/v3f/springgaus_fewshot.RUNS, K0 = mean z over runs), single view (V=1), unchanged weights, zero-shot

categories_and_literature_stiffness.note: order-of-magnitude log10(E/rho) in m^2/s^2 of the bulk material from standard handbooks; used ONLY as an ordinal target. Our prior's training range is E/rho ~ 1e-1..1e3 m^2/s^2 (soft solids), so every rigid object is out of range; the test is ordinal only.

cardboard.tier: excluded from primary endpoints (hollow box; structural stiffness not given by material E)

unit_of_analysis: object: mean of per-trial predicted z_E (ensemble mean) over that object's included trials on the primary surfaces

endpoints.P1_primary: object-level pairwise ordering accuracy (= AUC) of predicted log10(E/rho): soft tier (5 rubber objects) predicted softer than rigid tier (plastic+wood+metal objects). Chance = 0.5. 95% CI: stratified object bootstrap (10000).
endpoints.P2: object-level Spearman rho between predicted log10(E/rho) and the literature category value, all objects except cardboard (rubber, foam, plastic, wood, metal). 95% CI: object bootstrap.
endpoints.S1: P1 and P2 on all 5 surfaces and on each surface separately (descriptive)
endpoints.S2: trial-level P1 AUC (descriptive, trials not independent)
endpoints.S3: law (class) probabilities per tier, descriptive only (no dough in the fall scenario, so no plasticine GT exists; a rigid object has no class in our taxonomy)
endpoints.S4: predicted log10 rho vs measured density mass/volume, Spearman (descriptive; density is not identifiable from a free-fall video, expected near 0)

baselines.constant: same prediction for every object: AUC 0.5, Spearman 0
baselines.first_frame_appearance: same 9-run ensemble fed a static clip (the release frame, masked/cropped identically, repeated 64 times, same times): appearance-only prediction from the same model
baselines.squash_statistic: non-learned motion cue: max over post-release frames of relative vertical mask-bbox compression (1 - h_t / median h over the first 3 post-release frames), clipped >= 0, averaged over trials; predicted stiffness = -squash

comparisons: prior minus first-frame and prior minus squash on P1 and P2, paired object bootstrap 95% CI
success_criteria: P1 lower CI bound > 0.5 = the prior orders soft vs rigid real objects above chance. Superiority over first-frame requires the paired CI to exclude 0; otherwise reported as 'not shown to come from motion'.
replay_metrics: not attempted on Physics 101: single uncalibrated view per camera, no shared calibration between Camera_1/Camera_2/Kinect, no object geometry; v3v-style held-out-camera replay is infeasible within the budget
deviations_policy: any change after first metric is logged in docs/v3w/deviations.json and labelled post hoc
